headline: South Africa Removes 75 Construction Companies from Register in Grading Review
summary: South Africa's public works ministry removed 75 construction firms from the CIDB contractor register since June 2024 to tighten governance, compared to only one firm removed over the preceding 22 years.
why: South Africa's Construction Industry Development Board (CIDB) determines contractor eligibility for public infrastructure procurement and tender allocation.

impacts.name: South African Construction
impacts.why: Tighter compliance weeds out unqualified operators but narrows the bidding pool for state-funded infrastructure contracts.
